text:
jules: Quick friday wind-down: pick ONE song + ONE short story that youd7d put on before lights-out. no lists. i'll start: 'Night Air' (Metronomy) + 'The Paper Menagerie' by Ken Liu. cozy ache.
omar: nice. mine: 'Moon River' (Henry Mancini instrumental) + 'A Good Man Is Hard to Find' by Flannery O'Connor. vintage chill, then yikes. :sweat_smile:
liz: going sleepy but weird: 'Nanna' (Grouper) + 'The Lottery' by Shirley Jackson. faintly unsettling nap.
ben: gentle pick: 'For Emma' (Bon Iver acoustic) + 'A Clean, Well-Lighted Place' by Hemingway. quiet and tiny.
meme-bot: bedtime PSA: ambient tracks + short stories may cause introspection. :thought_balloon: reactions: :thumbsup: x2
jules: if you like anothers combo, drop a "+1" and the name.
omar: +1 @ben (For Emma + Hemingway)
liz: +1 @jules (Night Air + Paper Menagerie)
ben: thanks @omar. low-key want to swap Moon River for an instrumental harp sometimes.
jules: tally: jules 1, omar 0, liz 1, ben 1. this was delightful. next round: one-song one-film? :popcorn:
